meta.description: Hyper-realistic cinematic AI-generated images of Japanese warriors — samurai in full armor or unarmored ronin — set against dramatic atmospheric landscapes. Aesthetic blends ancient warrior culture with modern motivational content.

visual_style.overall: Ultra-realistic cinematic photography, NOT illustration or painting. Looks like a movie still from a high-budget samurai epic (Ghost of Tsushima / 47 Ronin aesthetic). Hyper-detailed textures, film grain, shallow depth of field.
visual_style.color_grade: Dark, desaturated base with selective color accents. Cold steel blues and charcoal blacks dominate. Selective warm pops: deep crimson, burnt orange, golden amber. NO bright or neon colors.
visual_style.contrast: High contrast. Deep crushed blacks, bright specular highlights on metal surfaces. HDR-like but cinematic.
visual_style.mood: Stoic, heavy, ancient, inevitable. No happiness or softness. Pure silent strength and discipline.

type_A_armored_samurai.description: Full samurai in complete yoroi armor with kabuto helmet
armor_details: Heavily weathered and battle-worn lacquered plates
Scratches, dents, rain droplets on metal surfaces
Mengu (demon/oni face mask) on most helmets — fierce expression
armor_colors: Primary: Matte black / dark charcoal (most common, 50%)
Secondary: Deep red and black combination (30%)
Rare: Dark steel blue (10%), weathered grey (10%)
type_A_armored_samurai.weapons: Katana — either sheathed at hip, held at side, or raised. Occasionally yumi (bow).

type_B_unarmored_ronin.description: Japanese male warrior in dark robes without armor
appearance: East Asian male, approximately 35-45 years old
Strong angular jaw, defined cheekbones, intense dark eyes
Long dark hair — either tied back in loose topknot or flowing wet in wind
Several days of stubble or short beard
Expression: stoic, cold, focused — never smiling
clothing: Dark grey or black kimono / hakama
Layered dark robes, worn and rough-textured
Fabric moves in wind, sometimes wet from rain
type_B_unarmored_ronin.weapons: Katana at hip or held loosely at side

type_C_silhouette.description: Lone warrior as pure silhouette against dramatic sky
type_C_silhouette.details: Full body silhouette, often from behind, wearing kasa (conical straw hat) and holding katana. Background is explosive orange/gold sunset or fire.

extreme_closeup.description: Face of helmet/mask filling 70%+ of frame. Extreme detail on metal texture, scratches, rain drops. Eyes visible through visor — burning with intensity.

medium_portrait.description: Chest-to-head shot. Warrior facing camera directly or slight 3/4 angle. Background blurred (bokeh). Low camera angle looking slightly upward.

full_body_low_angle.description: Full body from ground level. Warrior appears monumental, towering against dramatic sky. Often on horseback.

from_behind.description: Warrior seen from behind, facing vast landscape. Conveys solitude and purpose. Horizon visible ahead of them.

profile_side.description: Clean profile view. Warrior looking into distance. Dramatic rim lighting separates them from background.

foggy_grey_plains.description: Misty overcast landscape. Low hanging fog. Barren ground. Bokeh lights in far distance (campfires, lanterns). Cold desaturated tones.

golden_wheat_fields.description: Tall golden-amber grass field. Warm backlight (sunset/sunrise). Grasses blowing in wind. Cinematic orange glow.

rain_storm.description: Heavy rain visible as diagonal streaks. Wet surfaces with reflections. Dark storm clouds. Bokeh light points in background.

crimson_flower_field.description: Field of bright red poppies or cosmos flowers. Strong contrast with dark warrior. Occasionally pink cherry blossoms. Sometimes combined with misty grey sky.

snowy_mountains.description: Snowfall. White peaks in background. Warrior dusted with snow. Cold blue-white palette.

fire_and_embers.description: Burning battlefield. Orange fire light from behind. Floating embers. Smoke. Apocalyptic orange sky.

sunset_silhouette.description: Explosive orange/gold sunset. Pure silhouette of warrior. Dramatic cloud formations.

lighting.primary: Overcast diffused light — gives even cinematic look
lighting.rim_light: Strong rim/backlight separating subject from background — creates heroic glow around armor edges
lighting.dramatic_contrast: Faces and armor in deep shadow with bright highlights on raised surfaces
lighting.rain_reflections: Wet surfaces catch and reflect light sources for texture depth
lighting.golden_hour: When used — explosive warm backlighting, subject silhouetted or front-lit with warm orange

atmosphere.feeling: Ancient. Final. Inevitable. The silence before battle. Total commitment. No escape, no retreat.

claude_generation_instruction: You are generating image prompts for mushinjournal Instagram style. Choose ONE character type based on frequency (armored samurai 65%, unarmored ronin 30%, silhouette 5%), ONE camera angle, ONE background. Combine into a single detailed prompt with quality tags. Output only the prompt in English, 2-4 sentences. Vary each generation: armor color, weather detail, specific lighting direction, battle damage details, specific flora species, cloud formations. Never repeat the same combination twice.
